title: Random forest predicts 3-year cardiovascular disease in Korean type 2 diabetes
summary: The best model, a random forest, predicted cardiovascular disease at 3 years with AUROC 0.830 (95% CI 0.818-0.842) in the discovery cohort (n = 12,809; 1,238 cases) and 0.722 (0.660-0.783) in a validation cohort of 2,019 patients from two other hospitals. Creatinine and glycated hemoglobin were the most influential factors. The data are retrospective and external discrimination is moderate.
ai_technology: Random forest chosen among several hyperparameter-tuned ML models
organization: Kyung Hee University; Kyung Hee University Medical Center

evidence.tested: Validation in a separate two-hospital cohort.
evidence.unknown: Prospective validation; an earlier JMIR preprint was not checked.

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read. Publisher version not otherwise accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
